summary: Describes how Mobile IPv6 Fast Handovers can be used on 3G CDMA cellular networks. Mobile IPv6 is used there to keep connectivity as the device moves between access routers, but the usual handover steps cause delay. This informational document explains how to shorten that delay so connections are interrupted less.

eli5.summary: Moving between phone towers can make a call stutter. This explains how to prepare the next tower in advance on a particular type of mobile network, so the hand-off is smoother.
